what.text: This page follows refugees from the Central African Republic living in Sudan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6424 Central African refugees in Sudan, 1.0% of all refugees from the Central African Republic.
Cameroon hosts the most Central African refugees, followed by the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Chad.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of the Central African Republic in periods from 2002 to 2025, with Seleka, anti-Balaka, UPC and CPC among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2019 to 2023, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2007 at 2500 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 27613, at the end of 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sudan.
These are year-end totals for Sudan only, reported to UNHCR.
